chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"A man should bury his nails and hair when he trims them, and this is a sunnah (prophetic tradition)."

key_terms.أَخَذَ: he took; meaning he cut or removed
key_terms.أَظَافِيرَهُ: his nails; the trimmed fingernails or toenails
key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man; here referring to a person performing grooming
key_terms.سُنَّةٌ: a sunnah (prophetic tradition); an established recommended practice
key_terms.شَعْرَهُ: his hair; hair removed from the body
key_terms.يَدْفِنُ: he buries; meaning to place removed hair and nails into the earth

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about disposing of cut nails and hair?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs that a person should bury the hair and nails removed from the body. The hadith presents this practice as part of the sunnah (prophetic tradition) and the etiquette of personal cleanliness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.316 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"A man should bury his nails and hair when he trims them, and this is a Sunnah."
